items.title: Marvell (MRVL) Stock Trades At A Premium After A 290% Run
items.summary: Marvell Technology stock has delivered a very strong 289.6% return over the past three years, yet current valuation checks suggest the shares are priced at a premium rather than standing out as a clear bargain. The 289.6% three year return highlights how strongly sentiment has shifted in favor of Marvell Technology and raises the bar for what future fundamentals may need to justify. Investor focus on Marvell’s role in AI data center and memory infrastructure can support high expectations,...

items.title: Quantum-Si Incorporated (QSI) Reports Q2 Loss, Tops Revenue Estimates
items.summary: QuantumSi Incorporated (QSI) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +15.39% and +4.24%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Reddit Shares Surge on S&P 500 Inclusion Later This Month
items.summary: Reddit Inc. will join the S&P 500 next week as part of an off-cycle change, S&P Dow Jones Indices said Thursday, sending the social networking platform’s shares surging more than 10% after the bell.

items.title: AMD Stock Can Halve Or Nearly Double, And That Is The Calm Assumption
items.summary: Options are priced for a calmer stretch than the stock just delivered, and even that assumption leaves room to lose close to half a position or nearly double it.

items.title: Lumentum Puts The Insane Opportunity for Companies like Marvell and Ciena Into Focus With One Stunning Quote
items.summary: A single quote from Lumentum's CEO reveals just how staggering the AI networking buildout has become, and it reframes why a handful of optical companies that spent a decade going nowhere are now posting the kind of share gains that make investors question everything they thought they knew about this space.

items.title: Cerebras Plummets 13% After Earnings. But Intel & AMD Barrel Ahead with Strong Gains.
items.summary: Cerebras is getting crushed after earnings while nearly every other AI chip and infrastructure name surges to fresh highs. What one company's bad day reveals about where this trade is actually headed matters more than the headline loss.

items.title: Down 37% From Its Highs, Is Marvell Technology Stock a Buy on the Dip?
items.summary: The stock is cheaper as management raises its long-term outlook for data center demand.

items.title: Credo Targets AI's Memory Wall With Open Chiplet Interconnect Standard
items.summary: CRDO is advancing open interconnect standards to tackle AI memory bottlenecks and enable more flexible, modular data-center architectures.
